generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Contractors shall have to be financially sound. They cannot depend on KPCL bill payment to pay labors. The Labors must be paid by 10th of every month. No delay in this statutory compliance shall be tolerated.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
It shall be the responsibility of the bidder to furnish all the particulars which are required for due consideration of the tender though not mentioned in the specification.
Tender validity shall be 180 days from the date specified for last date for submission of the tender.
The right to reject any or all tenders without assigning the reasons is reserved by the Chief Engineer (FM), BTPS.

The bidder should submit details of place of residence and postal address. The delivery at the above name, place or position in the post box regularly maintained by the post office or sending by letter registered for acknowledgement or other communications shall be deemed sufficient proof thereof.
The submission of tender by a contractor implies that he has read these notices and conditions of contract and made himself aware of the scope of the work to be done.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor at least one contract pertaining to Supply, Erection & Commissioning of Belt Rip Monitoring System or Technical audit & rectification of sway of belt conveyors in any coal handling plants / material handling plants or Design, Manufacture, Supply of engineered conveyor skirts boards for spillage free transfer point solution in any coal handling plants / material handling plants of value not less than Rs.19.80 lakhs (exclusive of GST) in any one year during the preceding five years. The intended bidder shall upload the scanned copy of satisfactory work done certificate from public organisation/reputed private organization issued by competent authority in preceding five years. (Work done value for previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited).

The intending bidder shall not have been subject to forfeiture of EMD/foreclosure/ termination of their contract in KPCL/government or any other utility and have not been blacklisted for participation in tender issued by KPCL or government or any other utility in India during the past 5 years. The intended bidder should upload the scanned copy of Declaration as per annexure I.

The intending bidder in his name should have average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.39.59 lakhs (exclusive of GST) in any two of the preceding five years and should upload the scanned copy of original latest audited balance sheets including profit and loss account countersigned by charted accountant as documentary evidence. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders is invited).
